parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Direct physical inspection (E1) confirmed that the internal motion linkage of the valve was damaged, causing internal position discordance with the handle. Operation logs (E2) show no manual repositioning during the temperature drop, contradicting the hypothesis of intentional operator tampering. A second temperature measurement (E3) validated that the low temperature was genuine rather than an instrumentation artifact. Therefore, mechanical linkage failure is the primary cause.
uncertainty_notes: Earlier valve-maintenance records were unavailable to verify prior mechanical condition or wear history.
Operational logs could theoretically fail to capture unlogged actions, but physical linkage damage directly accounts for the valve misalignment.
